item.f16addon.enemy_f16_deployer.tooltip: Deploys an enemy F-16 with ammo. Its weapons are controlled by the addon's own AI.
item.f16addon.enemy_bmpt72_deployer.tool: Deploys an enemy BMPT-72 with 30mm, machine-gun and ATGM ammo.
item.f16addon.enemy_t80_deployer.tooltip: Deploys an enemy T-80 with 125mm, machine-gun and heavy ammo.
item.f16addon.enemy_wasp_deployer.toolti: Deploys a stationary AKM Wasp SAM. 1000-block range, but only 400 blocks against fifth-generation fighters; intercepts missiles first, then visible airborne targets at least 8 blocks above ground. Blocked and low targets are ignored.
item.f16addon.ground_command_tablet.tool: Right-click to command BMPT-72/T-80: advance, hold, follow or stop. Detection range 328 blocks.
item.f16addon.f16_targeting_pod.tooltip: Right-click to open the target lock screen. Nearby enemy F-16s will prioritize the locked target.
